name: Summer Camp Sidekick Volunteer (Polk County Conservation)
what_you_do: Help naturalists run nature camps for kids ages 6 to 11 at Jester Park. You help with games, crafts and outdoor activities. Training is provided and no experience is needed.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 and up. You must be 14 by June 1 to apply. You need to be comfortable outside in all weather.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer role. Hours can count toward the Silver Cord award.
duration: The full length of the camp you pick. Camps are 2 to 5 days, mostly in June and July, 9 AM to 3:30 PM at Jester Park.
deadline_text: For 2026 the application deadline was May 1. 2027 dates: not stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the volunteer form and one more set of questions. Then do an online training and orientation. Staff will contact you after they get your form. Send questions to heidi.anderson@polkcountyiowa.gov or call 515-323-5360.
notes: You keep track of your own hours and bring the paperwork for Silver Cord. The program page also lists Nature Center volunteering on the same volunteer menu.
